explanation_short: The SVM model's performance is characterized by an R2 score of 0.7324 and a strong correlation of 0.86576 between predicted and actual values.
explanation_full: The analysis of the SVM model reveals several key performance indicators. The model achieved an R2 score of 0.7324, indicating a solid fit to the data. Furthermore, the correlation coefficient between predicted and actual values was 0.86576, suggesting that the model's predictions track the actual values closely. The Mean Absolute Error (MAE) was 0.0946, which quantifies the average magnitude of the prediction error. These metrics collectively provide a comprehensive view of the model's predictive capability, grounding the assessment in quantitative evidence.
